member.name: T:GlowmaskHelper.Content.AutoloadGlowmask
member.summary:
This attribute annotates a or class to indicate that the game should autoload a glowmask texture for this entity.
The glowmask texture will be autoloaded from the regular texture + "_Glow". An error will be thrown if this texture is not found.

member.name: T:GlowmaskHelper.Content.GlowmaskLoader
member.summary:
This class serves as the central place to store and register custom glowmasks, and can be used to access information about them.
Using an attribute in your classes will do all the special logic for you, so you usually don't need to use this class if that's the case.
Currently only supports adding glowmasks to s and s.
